description.value: Monster Vineyards is a boutique winery in Penticton that playfully debunks the Ogopogo legend of Lake Okanagan, celebrating the imaginative contraptions people might have built to fake the mythical creature. Winemaker Stefan Arnason sources grapes from select Okanagan vineyards to produce bold, fruit-forward wines available through an on-site tasting room and wine shop. A patio is referenced in the photo gallery, making it a potential rest stop for cyclists exploring the South Okanagan wine route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and confirms an active winery with a tasting room and wine shop at 1010 Tupper Ave, Penticton. The phone number matches OSM, but the postal code on the website (/about/ page: V2A 8S5) differs from OSM (V2A 8T6). The OSM name 'Monster Vinyards' is a misspelling — the website consistently uses 'Monster Vineyards'. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
